Beside a dry grove a tally splits arrivals by the low 8 bits of the payer hash so a willow cluster cannot flood one bin.
Mechanism: hollow-bin-levy
How: each bin on the summit desk holds 3 receipts per 10 blocks.
Cost: receipt 4 posts 1.9 escrow for 7 epochs; receipt 5 posts 2.7 and waits 4 epochs.
Check: a bin that exceeds 3 receipts in that window applies the levy once.
